settings.tagline: Machine embroidery designs, digitised by hand.
settings.announcement: Instant download · pay by UPI · choose your machine format at checkout

designs.name: Mughal Bloom
designs.summary: A twelve-petal rosette with a satin centre — the motif every mughal jaali borrows from.
designs.description: Drawn from a 17th-century jaali in Fatehpur Sikri and redigitised for a 4-inch hoop. Petals are satin-stitched with a running underlay so they sit proud of the fabric without puckering. Sews cleanly on cotton, silk and organza.

designs.name: Peacock Court
designs.summary: Concentric rings with sixteen radiating spokes — a court medallion for lehengas and table linen.
designs.description: Built for the centre of a lehenga panel or a large cushion face. Three rings of satin and a sixteen-spoke lattice give it the density of a woven brocade without the weight. Best on dupion or raw silk.

designs.name: Paisley Vine
designs.summary: A single boteh with an inner curl and five seed dots — the Kashmiri paisley, digitised.
designs.description: The outline runs in a bean stitch for a raised edge, the inner curl in satin, and five seed dots finish the tail. Scales cleanly from a kurta placket to a stole border.

designs.name: Phulkari Border
designs.summary: Six scallops with a double running rule — repeat it along a dupatta or a hem.
designs.description: A repeating border designed to be hooped end to end: the first and last stitch land on the same baseline, so consecutive repeats join without a visible seam. Includes seed-dot accents.

designs.name: Laurel Monogram
designs.summary: A laurel wreath with a star crown — leave the centre empty for initials or a motif.
designs.description: Fourteen laurel leaves set along a satin ring, with a five-point star at the crown. The centre is deliberately clear so your monogram or a small motif can be dropped in.

designs.name: Bandhani Dot Field
designs.summary: Thirty-five tie-dye dots in three thread colours — an all-over fill that tiles.
designs.description: The dotted ground of a bandhani, stitched rather than tied. Rows and columns are evenly pitched so the field tiles across a kurta or a quilt without matching seams.

designs.name: Chikankari Vine
designs.summary: A climbing vine with seven paired leaves — the Lucknow running vine, light enough for mulmul.
designs.description: Worked in a fine running stitch with leaf loops, so the density stays low enough for summer mulmul. Seven leaves per repeat, alternating sides, mirrored so pairs read as one motif.

designs.name: Lotus Medallion
designs.summary: Eight broad lotus petals around a dense satin core — heavy enough for a blouse back.
designs.description: Broad petals with a dense satin core, built for a blouse back or a bridal panel. Higher stitch density than the Mughal Bloom; use a cut-away stabiliser on stretch fabric.
